Follow the budget. Make your voice count.

Request public records, follow county budget stages, and prepare public participation submissions for review and filing.

Article 35 | Access to Information Act, No. 31 of 2016

Request public information

Prepare a formal request addressed to a county, ministry, or public department. The generated document includes the statutory 21-day response period.

Article 35 | Access to Information Act, No. 31 of 2016

Formal Access to Information Request

Complete the fields to prepare a request for a public entity. The PDF is generated in your browser and is not sent to this website.

The 21-day response period is subject to the Access to Information Act. Check the relevant public entity's submission requirements.

Article 201 | Public Finance Management Act, 2012

County Budget Cycle Tracker

Expand a stage to see its statutory deadline, process, and suggested citizen actions. Public hearing dates and submission windows are announced separately by each county.

Articles 10, 118 and 201

Turn your views into a submission

Add one or more clause or budget-item references, state your concerns, and propose replacement amendments or actions. The generator creates a PDF locally in your browser.
